# Pixel Task List

An offline, pixel-styled task list built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No storage, no network — all state lives in memory.

## Features

- Add tasks via the input (ID `todo-input`) and Add button (ID `todo-add`), or press Enter.
- Input is trimmed; blank entries are ignored.
- Total tasks shown in `#todo-total`, incomplete tasks in `#remaining` (both start at 0).
- Each task gets increasing numeric IDs with elements:
  - Text: `#todo-text-<id>`
  - Checkbox: `#todo-check-<id>`
  - Delete button: `#todo-delete-<id>`
- Toggling a checkbox updates the remaining count.
- Deleting a task removes it and updates both counts.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Accessibility

- All controls are labeled (visible or `sr-only` labels / `aria-label`).
- Full keyboard support with visible focus states.
- Responsive layout works down to 360px wide.
